fonts.display: 'Proxima Nova', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Lora', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes, link text on light surfaces

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark photography and dark surfaces

palette.name: Char
palette.role: Dark surface panels, navigation pill background, elevated dark cards

palette.name: Midnight
palette.role: Deepest surface for dark feature cards and modal backgrounds

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Mid-dark panel surface, secondary dark backgrounds behind photography

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Cool-tinted dark surface, used for subtle contrast against warmer darks

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Light card surfaces, hairline borders on white, image overlay tints

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Muted helper text, secondary borders, inactive metadata

palette.name: Ember
palette.role: Link text, brand accent, warm highlight on muted cards — single chromatic accent that warms an otherwise neutral system

palette.name: Pine
palette.role: Dark green surface for feature cards and link backgrounds on light

palette.name: Tide
palette.role: Deep teal-dark surface for link and card backgrounds, complements Pine in the cool brand register

palette.name: Driftwood
palette.role: Decorative stroke and fill for illustrations and icon-line work, soft cool gray with depth

palette.name: Cedar
palette.role: Warm brown card surface, earth-toned card variant

palette.name: Coral
palette.role: Warm-pink card surface, used as an occasional warm-tinted card variant

palette.name: Primary Action Fill
palette.role: Neutral button treatment for secondary actions and selected controls. Use as the primary filled action background
